evidence.quote: Please note: EU citizens pay no tuition fees, for non-EU citizens the tuition fee is 1500 EUR per semester.
All applicants must hand in the following application documents: 1. School completion certificate (certified and transcripted)

notes: The tuition fee of 1500 EUR per semester is a fee for non-EU students at Baden-Württemberg universities ('Bitte beachten Sie: EU-Bürger zahlen keine Studiengebühren, für Nicht-EU-Bürger beträgt die Studiengebühr 1500 EUR pro Semester.'). The semester contribution of 188 EUR per semester is a general fee, not tuition, and is not included. The application period (4 May to 15 September) is stated generally for all countries on the DAAD page and on the HKA programme page, so it is recorded as a recurring deadline (15 September, no year). The application channel is the university's own portal according to the pages; no mention of uni-assist was found.

evidence.quote: An English language certificate is required for all international applicants (TOEFL certificate with at least ibt 83, or an equivalent English test).
English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: IELTS Academic: 5.5
Bachelor Electrical Engineering & Information Technology: English B2 / IELTS / TOEFL
German language skills A1 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: Goethe-Zertifikat A1
To apply, you will need an A1 German certificate, which must be submitted no later than 6 weeks after the start of lectures.

note.fr: Les candidats non-UE doivent obtenir un certificat ASK du Studienkolleg de Constance pour la reconnaissance de leurs diplômes. Contactez l'ASK le plus tôt possible (délais différents).
note.en: Non-EU applicants must obtain an ASK certificate from the Studienkolleg in Konstanz for recognition of their diplomas. Contact the ASK as early as possible (different deadlines).

evidence.quote: Zuerst lassen Sie vom Studienkolleg Konstanz Ihre Schulunterlagen und, wenn vorhanden, Studiennachweise daraufhin prüfen, ob Sie eine Hochschulzugangsberechtigung (HZB) haben.

note.fr: Vous devez participer à un test d'orientation (par ex. was-studiere-ich) et soumettre l'attestation de participation avec votre demande d'inscription.
note.en: You must take an orientation test (e.g. was-studiere-ich) and submit the certificate of participation with your enrollment application.

evidence.quote: In accordance with legal requirements, applicants must take the aptitude test.
